$comment: Dubel Team football ecosystem contract. This file is IDENTICAL in all four repos (fanlife, Offsides, Dubid, The-Worker). Change it in one repo => copy the same bytes to the other three in the same round. Bump version + updated.

legacy.pqdzqpettxuuyngxbpxn: OFFSIDES' former DB (org maor@har-tov.com's Org). Migrated to schema `offsides` on Football Master on 2026-10-20 (structure, 437 functions, data, 227 users). Kept read-only until the owner retires it.

authRules: No app adds triggers on auth.users. Profiles are created lazily by each app's own ensure_* RPC.
Every app adds only its own Redirect URLs; never change the Site URL without updating every app.

SSO: a real account's session is ONE cookie, sb-afxpjfxwpdjvlmuoawda-auth-token, on .dubelteam.com, in @supabase/ssr format. Next apps set cookieOptions.domain = ssoCookieDomain(host); other apps use ssoStorage() from ecosystem/sdk.ts. Host-only on localhost and previews.

Anonymous sessions are never shared: a guest belongs to the app that created it. When a real account arrives, the app parks its guest (takeParkedGuest) and moves the guest's progress with its own merge (DUBID: issue_merge_token → claim_pass).
Sign-out uses scope 'local': it ends the session in THIS browser — every app on this browser at once (one cookie) — and never other devices.
supabase.exposedSchemasNote: Set in the dashboard (Integrations → Data API → Settings → Exposed schemas). Never set pgrst.db_schemas on the authenticator role: it silently overrides the dashboard.

writes: fy_* tables on its own Supabase project (TakeMeOut, wvxzhjaerfmrlvirbasc); anonymous, no accounts, nothing on Football Master

core.owner: dubid today → contract (step 2 of the data engine)
core.what: football facts: leagues, seasons, teams, players, squads, matches, external_refs, entity_aliases

shared.readers: all, through RPCs only (no table grants)
shared.what: person (one per auth user), app_membership (which apps, first-touch source), handoff (cross-app leads), reward_grants (value between apps), schema_migrations (registry), integration_health
shared.sql: ecosystem/sql/NNNN_*.sql — byte-identical in every repo, applied in order, registered as app 'ecosystem' in shared.schema_migrations

offsides.readers: offsides app via PostgREST (db.schema='offsides'); realtime on profiles, broadcasts, matches, events, arenas, bets, flash_questions, flash_answers
offsides.profiles: offsides.ensure_profile() — lazy, no auth trigger; anonymous users get none

public.worker_*.rule: Only fanlife adds migrations. The-Worker mirrors the files byte-for-byte and never writes its own.
public.worker_*.what: FAN LIFE + THE WORKER app data (collector, market, stands, polls, files)

public.{arenas,bets,profiles,questions,s.rule: Legacy stubs from the first shared-project attempt. Do not use, do not drop until phase 4 decides.

marketing.readers: none — server only (pg_cron → marketing.dispatch(), SECURITY DEFINER). Not exposed to the Data API, no grants to anon/authenticated.
marketing.what: DUBEL TEAM social plan: posts (30 days × 8 slots, 08:00–22:00 Israel time), settings (meta, copy pools, telegram chat). Match slots resolve the real fixture from core.fixtures at send time; the owner gets each post (hook, caption, link, hashtags, visual brief) on Telegram.
marketing.secrets: Vault: telegram_bot_token (the owner adds it in Dashboard → Vault).

edgeFunctions.offsides: offsides-* (hyper-responder, match-autopilot, momentum-odds, sync-team-logos, notify-send, daily-streak, duel-push, fb-post). The unprefixed sync-fixtures-index, sync-team-logos, momentum-odds on Football Master are leftovers of the first attempt and are not called.

cron.fanlife: GitHub Actions; pg_cron marketing:* (marketing:telegram, every 2 minutes)

migrations.theworker: mirror of fanlife's worker_* files only

crossAppLinks.how: RPC game.current_gameweek / game.gameweek_state with anon key

crossAppLinks.status: live, VIOLATION: cross-app table read; replace with shared view in phase 2

crossAppLinks.how: edge fn link-offsides verifies an Offsides token; rewards via shared.reward_grants -> offsides.dubid_rewards
shared.handoff (?eh=<token>) → handoff_open on landing → handoff_claim once a session exists
crossAppLinks.status: live in DB 2026-10-19; wired per app

rules: 1. An app writes only to schemas it owns. Cross-app reads go through views/RPCs in core, hub or shared.
2. Currencies never mix. Value crosses apps only through shared.reward_grants.
3. Before any DB change: read the live object (pg_get_functiondef / list_tables) — never rebuild a live function from a repo file.
4. Never deploy a migration or edge function whose prefix belongs to another app. Shared SQL lives only in ecosystem/sql and is the same bytes everywhere.
5. A change to contract.json, shared or core is a four-repo change: same round, same contract version.
6. Football identity: every team/player an app shows must be resolvable to core via core.external_refs (phase 3).
7. Domains: all apps live under *.dubelteam.com (SSO cookie scope, phase 2).
8. Ownership of shared things: identity, membership, leads and the reward ledger belong to the contract (schema shared), never to one app. An app reads them only through the RPCs above.
9. Every app registers its own future migrations in shared.schema_migrations under its own app id.
10. The universe map lives in shared.apps / shared.app_moments. A cross-app link carries its moment (campaign '<moment>' or '<moment>-<x>'); a new app or moment is a row, not code.
11. DUBID and OFFSIDES never parse a provider themselves: they read through ecosystem/feed and, once core is shared, through core views only.

12. A club has one exact id across the universe: the core.teams uuid. An app's own name for it (FAN LIFE slug, provider id) is a row in core.external_refs, linked through a provider id, never a name. Ask shared.club_identity(slug).

13. Fixtures: every app reads core.fixtures (via shared.fixtures) and reacts to core.fixture_signals with its own cursor. core.weekly_matches is DUBID's gameweek schedule, not a shared table. Only core.publish_fixture writes core.fixtures.

rpc.shared.app_touch(app): authenticated — call once a session exists
rpc.shared.grant_reward / claim_reward: existing ledger, now all four apps
rpc.shared.universe(): anon — the public map: apps, roles, moments
rpc.shared.club_identity(slug): anon — the exact ids of a FAN LIFE club: core.teams uuid + every provider ref (ecosystem/sql/0003_club_ids.sql)
rpc.shared.fixtures(club, from, to): anon — the neutral fixture list (core.fixtures), optionally for one FAN LIFE club; window ≤120 days (ecosystem/sql/0004_fixtures.sql)
rpc.shared.fixture_signals_since(cursor, lim: service_role — what changed (created / kickoff_moved / status / score / removed) after a game's own cursor
rpc.core.publish_fixture(...) / core.unpubli: service_role — the one write path into core.fixtures; DUBID publishes from a trigger on core.weekly_matches (db/49)

vision.name: FAN LIFE UNIVERSE — The Smart Connection Engine
vision.line: Same club. Different journeys. One universe.
vision.companions: Different products, the same heart: a smart companion, never a replacement.
vision.source: owner's diagram, 19.10.2026; the database copy is shared.apps + shared.app_moments (ecosystem/sql/0002_universe.sql)

feed.module: ecosystem/feed/ (byte-identical) — the ONE data-reading engine of DUBID and OFFSIDES (and the hub later): provider adapters sofascore, scores365 (+ api-football, thesportsdb next)
feed.writer: core.ingest_snapshot (step 3) via edge fn feed-ingest; games react to core.fixture_signals with their own cron
